proposed_rules.title: Pin supported token dialect and serializer
proposed_rules.rule: Declare accepted syntax, effective type resolution, value schema and serialization for each supported type. Reject mixed or unsupported constructs instead of stringifying or guessing.
proposed_rules.falsifier: A supported dimension {value:1,unit:'px'} emits multiple value/unit tokens, '[object Object]', a double unit, or loses the unit; alternatively an unsupported object shape is accepted.
proposed_rules.unit_expectation: Either exact supported output 1px with retained dimension type, or explicit unsupported-construct error.

proposed_rules.title: Re-resolve every effective theme
proposed_rules.rule: Merge base plus one explicitly declared override set, then validate and resolve the resulting graph independently. Keep declared semantic role paths and types stable; permit alias targets to change.
proposed_rules.falsifier: base body->gray.900 and dark body->gray.50 resolve to the same cached target, or a dark-only missing reference/cycle/type mismatch passes.
proposed_rules.unit_expectation: All declared themes yield complete role maps with expected values; malformed dark-only graphs fail with theme and token path.

proposed_rules.title: Separate intentional overrides and generated collisions
proposed_rules.rule: Authorize duplicate source paths only through a declared merge order. Require generated CSS names and per-theme artifact destinations to be injective within their output namespace.
proposed_rules.falsifier: paths a.b and a-b both emit --a-b; dark and light outputs silently write the same file.
proposed_rules.unit_expectation: Both collisions fail with conflicting original paths or theme names; explicit base-to-theme replacement remains valid.

proposed_rules.title: Close exported reference graphs
proposed_rules.rule: For reference-preserving output, every reference must resolve in the declared output bundle and scope. Otherwise emit an explicitly resolved literal, or reject. A deliberately external variable needs an explicit contract.
proposed_rules.falsifier: semantic.text references palette.ink, only semantic tokens are exported, and output still refers to omitted --palette-ink.
proposed_rules.unit_expectation: No dangling emitted references; resolving a filtered dependency does not change its value. If export filters are out of scope, reject or document them as unsupported.

proposed_rules.title: Do not treat CSS fallback as type recovery
proposed_rules.rule: Validate local declared types before CSS emission. A bounded checker should reject raw CSS var(), calc(), interpolated aliases, or fallback expressions unless it actually implements their grammar and graph rules.
proposed_rules.falsifier: --x:16px; color:var(--x,red) is reported as guaranteed red or valid color because a fallback exists.
proposed_rules.unit_expectation: Token color-to-dimension alias fails. Unsupported raw expressions fail rather than being declared safe. Actual browser computed behavior remains untested.

proposed_rules.title: Declare theme scope semantics
proposed_rules.rule: A resolved token graph is not a CSS cascade simulator. Prefer fully resolved role values per declared theme scope; if keeping runtime aliases, state where dependent declarations are emitted and test nested scopes separately.
proposed_rules.falsifier: :root defines --base:red and --role:var(--base); a descendant changes only --base:blue; the tool claims inherited --role must become blue.
proposed_rules.unit_expectation: Static emitter asserts complete role declarations per supported scope. Nested scope equivalence is HOLD without browser tests.

proposed_rules.title: Local semantic role manifest
proposed_rules.rule: Use a product-owned list of required semantic roles and foreground/background pairings. Check presence and types after each theme merge, retaining source provenance. Do not invent a universally mandatory role inventory or token tier count.
proposed_rules.falsifier: Every present token resolves, but a required on-surface role is absent and the checker reports the theme complete.
proposed_rules.unit_expectation: Missing required role fails; inherited base role can satisfy the contract if explicit merge policy permits it.

proposed_rules.title: Keep compile and visual results separate
proposed_rules.rule: Report graph/type/name/theme checks only. Mark rendered contrast, focus visibility, forced colors and system preference handling as unverified unless separately measured in context.
proposed_rules.falsifier: A well-typed theme with a shadow-only focus indicator receives an accessibility or WCAG pass solely from token compilation.
proposed_rules.unit_expectation: Machine report never produces rendered accessibility conformance from graph success; visual checks remain HOLD.
